description: Changes one calendar event: the fields you pass, leaving the rest. Pass a series’ id to change all of it, or the `id` `get_agenda` gives one date of it to change only that date. With `send_invites: true` every attendee is emailed the change — only for an event this address organises, and only when you were asked to tell them. When retrying, reuse its `idempotency_key`.

idempotency_key.description: Any string unique to this send. Reuse the same key when retrying the same send, and it goes out once. Without one, an identical call within the hour counts as a retry.

name: update_calendar_event
title: Change a calendar event
